title: Cook-loop foundations: Library, Add review and Recipe Detail
summary: Screens 1-3 retain separately reviewed runtime bytes with independent ON/OFF flags, real saved/draft metadata and existing native actions. Bulk delete/collections/Meal Plan, multi-page scan and new variant/rescue claims remain deferred. All three UI classes and required unit sets retained. Combined source integration only; native build, tests, Journal, pixels and device acceptance unverified.
